description: Run one of our free tools. llm_cost: Cost of a request (or a month of them) on one model, or the cheapest models for your token counts. Args: model?, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens?, requests? | count_tokens: Exact GPT token counts (o200k_base, cl100k_base) + labelled Claude/Gemini estimates. Args: text | cron_explain: Cron in plain English + next runs. Args: expression, format? (auto|std|quartz|aws), timezone? (IANA), count? | semver_check: Which versions a Cargo or npm requirement matches. Args: requirement, ecosystem? (cargo|npm), versions? (list) or package? (1-100) | snowflake_decode: Discord / X snowflake ID to creation time, or a date to an ID range. Args: id or ids, platform? Args: text, required_keys? | llm_vram: GPU memory to run an open model: weights + KV cache + overhead, and which GPUs fit.
